required_view_additions.season_key: optional: competition season label of the scenario; without it the season comes from the seasons lookup by date (differs from the recorded season in 144 of 23,132 matches)
required_view_additions.bowl_end_umpire_p: optional: probability umpires[0] is at the bowler's end when bowl_end_umpire is None (in-play states with unknown ends)
required_view_additions.free_hit_p: training views only: probability of a free hit when free_hit is None
required_view_additions.weather.wet_day: scenario weather key for the precipitation feature (falls back to rain_risk)

notes.half_life: build_design takes the half-life in years; age in days from the match start, w = 0.5 ** (age / (365.25 * hl))
notes.cutoff_rule: a match enters only when its last played date is before the cutoff (stricter than its start date)
notes.labels: players and umpires are labelled by Cricsheet registry identifier (people_index.identifier); engines pass those ids
notes.outcome_label: onfield_class where drs_available is true, else the recorded outcome_class; wides leave the outcome and wk fits
notes.masks: class 6 masked on no-balls and certain free hits; 6,969 uncertain free hits (front-foot era) are unmasked and carry o_free_hit with weight free_hit_p; no recorded class-6 out falls on a masked row
notes.retirements: the ball table has no retirement-only rows (retirements are events), so that exclusion is empty
notes.phase: phase6/phase3 use elapsed = max_balls - balls_remaining (the ingest's over-position count); equal to legal balls in the engines; Tests have one phase level, so set x phase3 is set alone there
notes.ball_age: training ball_age_overs / second_new_ball are the ingest's over % 80 / over >= 80; engines use the simulated take-up
notes.newball: bat_newball / bowl_newball weight: limited overs phase3 == 0 (first powerplay span), Tests ball age <= 15 overs
notes.depth: realized later batting order gives the fallback rank of players without a role history; replaced-out non-batters dropped from the replacement innings on
notes.season: views without season_key use the competition's latest season started by the date (144 of 23,132 matches differ)
notes.nested: nested groups are additive under their parent (glm has no parent link); parents are kept in design.meta
notes.dtype_umpire: the bowler's-end umpire on dtype applies to both wide and no-ball classes
notes.wk_free_hit: the plan's 'free-hit/no-ball, masked to none' wk term is not a group: class-6 outs never occur on those rows
